lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming slightly more condensed towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line is abbreviated, terminating at the mid-shoulder level. The two posterior-most lines are discontinuous, appearing as a vertical series of spots rather than solid lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, with a higher density near the dorsal-posterior curve.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots are aligned in a horizontal geometric row across the upper portion of the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial lateral-posterior vector transitioning into a medial-dorsal ascent. The horns exhibit a spiral twist of approximately 180 degrees from base to tip.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.2 times the distance between the outer edges of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white chevron on the snout, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek, and a thick dark ventral fringe extending from the lower neck to the inguinal region.
